summary: Revision 10 maps all five P2 handoff findings to concrete owners, required behaviors, and checks. It requires actionable disconnect during initial reads with stale-response suppression; serialized heartbeat/read operations with independent failure state, retained cadence, and complete recovery; strict JSON whitespace validation without normalization and without rejected-request effects; originless same-origin reads using a capability paired for the bridge's own origin; and HTTP restart, WebSocket, metadata coverage plus Chromium expiry driven by actual bridge time/state. Plan and contract explicitly preserve the parent BB-01..10 and runtime handler/effect-counter requirements as incomplete.
review_boundary: Independent read-only review of plan.md revision 10 and contract.json, with targeted comparison against the registered security and client-contract provisions. Harness review-input returned identical bindings before and after review. This verdict approves the bounded repair plan, not implementation correctness or closure of the original code findings.
evidence_limits: No files edited, reports written, tests executed, services started, browsers operated, or subagents spawned.
The original five-finding code-review handoff was supplied through the assignment and represented in the closure matrix; its full original report was not independently inspected.
Planned synthetic-state equality assertions and static call-site review do not satisfy parent runtime handler/effect-counter requirements, including BB-02 and BB-09.
Actual browser enforcement, implementation behavior, production scenarios, SDK safety, OS isolation, and complete parent BB-01..10 coverage remain unverified.
